name: Ethan Herschenfeld
bio: Ethan Herschenfeld is a stand-up comedian, actor, and opera singer.  He started singing and acting as a student at Harvard which lead to full-time work on stage in New York City.

credits.title: Bound
credits.overview: To escape her overprotective drug-dealing stepfather, an introvert flees to NYC with her pet flying squirrel. After successfully reinventing herself through the help of some "found family," she realizes she must return home and confront her dark past, to truly be free.

credits.title: Bloat
credits.overview: After a near-death drowning accident, a young boy's family is horrified to discover he has become possessed by a legendary demon from the depths of the lake. As the family races against time to save the boy's soul, the evil monster inside the child tears the family apart as it seeks to destroy everyone in its path.

credits.title: Girl Haunts Boy
credits.overview: Cole, a teen grieving the loss of his dad, forms an unlikely bond with Bea, a ghost. As they navigate life and death, they must break an ancient curse.

credits.title: The Kill Room
credits.overview: A hitman, his boss, an art dealer and a money-laundering scheme that accidentally turns the assassin into an overnight avant-garde sensation, one that forces her to play the art world against the underworld.

credits.title: Daughter of the Bride
credits.overview: A close-knit relationship between a mother and her adult daughter is thrown into chaos when the mother reveals her secret engagement.

credits.title: Red Notice
credits.overview: An Interpol-issued Red Notice is a global alert to hunt and capture the world's most wanted. But when a daring heist brings together the FBI's top profiler and two rival criminals, there's no telling what will happen.
